origin.description: Reads a sas7bdat file, optionally applying labels from a sas7bcat catalog.
origin.usage: read_sas(data_file, catalog_file = NULL, encoding = NULL, catalog_encoding = encoding, col_select = NULL, skip = 0, n_max = Inf, cols_only = deprecated(), .name_repair = "unique")

arguments.name: data_file
arguments.text: Path or bytes of the sas7bdat file.

arguments.name: encoding
arguments.text: Override the encoding stored in the data file.

arguments.name: catalog_encoding
arguments.text: Override the catalog encoding. Defaults to encoding.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

arguments.name: cols_only
arguments.text: Deprecated. A warning is issued and the value is used as col_select.

origin.details: Date, datetime, and time formats become Date, POSIXct, and hms columns. A catalog adds value labels.
